info.name: CROIP Central Platform API
info.description:
Central Revenue Oversight & Integration Platform — all 11 microservice APIs, organized by WHO calls them rather than which service owns them:

- **1. Ratepayer** — citizen self-service: register, log in (password + OTP), complete profile, self-service property registration, own bills/disputes, receipt verification.
- **2. Concession** — revenue-collection partner field staff: property registration/verification in the field, billing and payment collection, event reporting, reference-data lookups.
- **3. CROIP Admin** — central platform/oversight staff: user & RBAC management, concession onboarding, reconciliation, audit, boundary/reference-data management, review/approval steps.
- **Platform Health Checks** — infra liveness/readiness, not tied to any persona.

Some endpoints are genuinely cross-cutting (e.g. a property verification is *submitted* by Concession staff but *reviewed* by CROIP Admin) — each lives under the persona who actually calls that specific endpoint, with a note where the split matters.

**Auth model**
- Ratepayer: no auth for register/claims/receipt-verification; phone/email + password + OTP issues `{{ratepayer_access_token}}` (HS256, ratepayer-service). Running 'Verify OTP' auto-saves it.
- Concession & CROIP Admin: both use the same real Zitadel-issued `{{staff_access_token}}` (RBAC permissions decide what each officer can actually do) — there's no API-only login by design; sign into the portal (http://localhost:3050) as a real officer and copy the access token (see README).

item.name: Auth & Profile
item.description: ratepayer-service — citizen plug-and-play signup and profile completion; accepts all ratepayer information at registration with only email/phone and password required, tracking omitted fields in completion metrics.

request.description: Single public registration endpoint that accepts all ratepayer profile fields. Only email (or phone number) and password (with confirmPassword) are strictly required. Either email or phone must be present. First name, last name, physical address, and coordinates point are explicit components of the profile completion metric (along with contact and KYC verification). Any information omitted or not inserted at registration will be dynamically tracked in completion metrics (missingSections). Profile details can be completed or updated at any time using the unified complete/update profile API.
Email OTPs are dispatched to Mailpit (http://localhost:8025). Phone OTPs are routed to Arkasel stub. devOtpCode is also included in dev response.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.devOtpCode) pm.environment.set('ratepayer_otp_code', j.devOtpCode); }

item.name: Login step 2: verify OTP → session token
Complete / Update own profile (using Bearer token)

request.description: Complete missing profile sections (such as setting password or legal name) or update any individual field using the ratepayer Bearer session token. Any field can be updated without having to provide others.

item.name: Verify KYC for own profile (Bearer token)

request.description: Verify KYC on own signed-in account using Bearer token. Supported providers: GHANA_CARD, PASSPORT, DRIVERS_LICENSE. Choosing a new provider archives previous verifications for audit trail.

item.name: Get a ratepayer profile by id (public)
Complete / Update profile by ID (single unified API)

request.description: Single unified endpoint for completing missing profile fields or updating existing details. The only required parameters are the ratepayer ID and authorization token. Anything can be updated (password, name, address, coordinates, etc.). Any omitted or updated fields immediately update the completion metrics.
Verify ratepayer using Ghana Card (NIA). Format: GHA-XXXXXXXXX-X. Choosing a new provider archives any previous active verification.
Verify ratepayer using Passport. Format: GXXXXXXXX. Archives previous Ghana Card verification for audit trail.
Verify ratepayer using Driver's License (DVLA). Format: DL-XXXXXXXX-X. Archives previous Passport verification for audit trail.

Delete an individual ratepayer profile. Strictly rejected with 400 Bad Request if the ratepayer has linked properties. To delete a ratepayer, first sever all property links or delete unbilled properties.

item.name: My Properties
item.description: property-registry-service + ratepayer-service — a property a ratepayer registers directly, updates, or claims from one a concession already registered.

request.description: Strictly requires ratepayer Bearer session token (HS256). Property creation requires that the ratepayer has completed their profile (including Address & Pinpoint Location) and has an approved KYC verification (isEligibleForPropertyCreation == true). Rejects with 400 Bad Request if KYC is unverified or profile is incomplete. Property is attributed to the logged-in ratepayer (createdByRatepayerId) and automatically linked in ratepayer-service. Ownership documents are mandatory. Spatial restriction: polygons cannot overlap or contain another property parcel if property uses and ownership match.

item.name: Update my property - metadata only (preserves valuation & status)

request.description: Ratepayer updates descriptive metadata (name, description, documents). Since core structural/use fields are unchanged, existing valuation and verification status remain intact.

item.name: Update my property - structural/usage change (resets to UNASSESSED, decouples valuation)

request.description: Ratepayer repurposes property or adds floors / changes physical characteristics. The property is automatically marked UNASSESSED, verificationStatus is reset to PENDING, and active valuations are decoupled from the parcel pending reassessment.
Sever the ownership or tenancy link between a ratepayer and an individual property parcel without deleting the property.

request.description: Also usable by the reviewing officer (CROIP Admin) — same endpoint, same permission check (raise-or-review).

item.name: Receipts
item.description: shared-services — lets a ratepayer (or anyone holding a receipt) confirm it's genuine.

item.name: Properties
item.description: property-registry-service — a concession's field agents registering and verifying properties in their assigned MMDAs.

request.description: Requires staff/concessionaire Bearer token. Concessions can only register properties whose polygon falls strictly within their assigned MMDA territory (enforced via Shared Services and Platform Governance). Spatial non-overlap restriction: polygons cannot overlap or contain another property parcel when property uses and ownership percentage match. Core classification fields are required; propertyName and documents are optional.

Concession batch registration (up to 500 properties). All properties must fall within the concession's assigned MMDA boundary. Core classification fields are required for each property; code is generated if omitted; propertyName and documents are optional.

item.name: Update property - metadata only (preserves valuation & status)

request.description: Concession staff updates property metadata. Non-structural updates preserve valuations and verification status.

item.name: Update property - structural / usage change (resets to UNASSESSED, decouples valuation)

request.description: Concession field staff updates physical structure or property use (e.g. building renovation, repurposing, adding floors). Automatically marks property UNASSESSED, resets verificationStatus to PENDING, and decouples active valuations pending re-assessment.
Reviewed/approved afterwards by CROIP Admin (see that folder's Property Oversight section).

Delete an individual property parcel. Strictly rejected with 400 Bad Request if any bills on this property have been paid (in which case only ratepayer links can be severed). If eligible for deletion, automatically severs all ratepayer links in ratepayer-service and cascades units, valuations, documents, and photos.

item.name: Admin Purge Operations
item.description: High-privilege admin purge operations. Permanently erases domain data while strictly preserving regions, MMDA boundaries, and superuser accounts.

request.description: Admin purge all registered property parcels, units, valuations, photos, documents, and verifications across all assemblies. Ghana regions and MMDA boundaries remain completely untouched.
Admin purge all partner concessionaires, assigned contracts, field personnel, and API clients. Strictly preserves the superuser account (superuser@croip.com) and SUPER_ADMIN RBAC role.
Admin purge all citizen & corporate ratepayer profiles, verifications, OTPs, and property claims. MMDA boundaries remain completely untouched.
Admin purge all property bills, payment links, and payment transaction records.
Admin purge all disputes, evidence files, and comments.
